## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 2/11 sectors positive. Confirmation: very narrow leadership (Top 5 are Technology) and a major divergence across large names (multiple SP100 stocks with 1W ≠ 1M), so avoid strong regime calls and treat action as tactical.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Technology leads: INTC (1W: +17.09% | 1M: +45.62%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +15.44% | 1M: +31.32%) ABOVE TREND, META (1W: +14.05% | 1M: +36.51%) ABOVE TREND. Healthcare is second: AMGN (1W: +7.89% | 1M: -8.52%) RECOVERY and LLY (1W: +3.87% | 1M: -5.22%) RECOVERY.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Utilities, Energy and Communication are weakest with negative 1W returns and the bulk of sectors below flat; Communication laggards include CHTR (1W: -12.93% | 1M: -21.79%) BELOW TREND and CMCSA cited in negative news. Industrials also show pockets of weakness: UPS (1W: -8.11% | 1M: -12.45%) BELOW TREND and GD (1W: -6.59% | 1M: -12.37%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: INTC (1W: +17.09% | 1M: +45.62%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +15.44% | 1M: +31.32%) ABOVE TREND, LRCX (1W: +14.18% | 1M: -2.28%) RECOVERY, META (1W: +14.05% | 1M: +36.51%) ABOVE TREND, AMAT (1W: +13.62% | 1M: -1.21%) RECOVERY. Leadership: Narrow (5/5 Technology) — concentration risk.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: GD (1W: -6.59% | 1M: -12.37%) BELOW TREND, CVS (1W: -7.27% | 1M: -9.63%) BELOW TREND, ORCL (1W: -7.34% | 1M: -3.61%) BELOW TREND, FDX (1W: -7.35% | 1M: -15.99%) BELOW TREND, F (1W: -7.42% | 1M: -9.68%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in Industrials and select Tech/consumer names; reduce exposure to names showing persistent 1M weakness.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Strongest 1W movers: INTC (1W: +17.09% | 1M: +45.62%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +15.44% | 1M: +31.32%) ABOVE TREND, META (1W: +14.05% | 1M: +36.51%) ABOVE TREND. Note divergence: several big 1W winners are RECOVERY (LRCX (1W: +14.18% | 1M: -2.28%), AMAT (1W: +13.62% | 1M: -1.21%), SHOP (1W: +12.88% | 1M: -5.67%)) — tactical momentum, not confirmation of broad trend.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Tech shows concentrated strength but mixed internals: NVDA (1W: +2.39% | 1M: +5.53%) ABOVE TREND, AAPL (1W: -0.32% | 1M: +8.40%) CORRECTION, MSFT (1W: +0.04% | 1M: +1.26%) ABOVE TREND, ORCL (1W: -7.34% | 1M: -3.61%) BELOW TREND, INTU (1W: -12.89% | 1M: -25.08%) BELOW TREND; Sector 1W: +2.98% | 1M: +5.63% (24 stocks). Style: mixed / no clear leadership given narrow top-weighting and weak breadth.

8. Financials Outlook?
Financials are soft on the week: JPM (1W: -3.08% | 1M: -5.08%) BELOW TREND, V (1W: -0.80% | 1M: -3.77%) BELOW TREND, MA (1W: -0.29% | 1M: -5.63%) BELOW TREND; Financials 1W: -1.87% | 1M: -6.28% (20 stocks). Watch for signs of stabilization; current action favors select risk-taking within stronger individual names rather than broad exposure.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Healthcare shows pockets of recovery and headline-driven moves: AMGN (1W: +7.89% | 1M: -8.52%) RECOVERY, LLY (1W: +3.87% | 1M: -5.22%) RECOVERY, PFE (1W: +3.46% | 1M: +1.57%) ABOVE TREND, JNJ (1W: +1.27% | 1M: -0.38%) RECOVERY; Healthcare 1W: +1.14% | 1M: -3.56% (17 stocks). News is a key driver; treat moves as catalyst-driven rather than broad demand.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor select Technology leaders and headline-driven Healthcare names while keeping overall beta controlled due to narrow leadership and major divergences; favor INTC (1W: +17.09% | 1M: +45.62%) ABOVE TREND and META (1W: +14.05% | 1M: +36.51%) ABOVE TREND, and favor AMGN (1W: +7.89% | 1M: -8.52%) RECOVERY. Reduce exposure to Industrials names showing sustained 1M downside (FDX (1W: -7.35% | 1M: -15.99%) BELOW TREND, UPS (1W: -8.11% | 1M: -12.45%) BELOW TREND); style: mixed / no clear leadership.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: INTC (1W: +17.09% | 1M: +45.62%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +15.44% | 1M: +31.32%) ABOVE TREND, META (1W: +14.05% | 1M: +36.51%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: ORCL (1W: -7.34% | 1M: -3.61%) BELOW TREND, INTU (1W: -12.89% | 1M: -25.08%) BELOW TREND, CCI (1W: -7.63% | 1M: -10.19%) BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Technology and Healthcare (Tech 1W: +2.98% | 1M: +5.63%; Healthcare 1W: +1.14% | 1M: -3.56%). BEARISH: Utilities and Energy are showing weakness to monitor (Utilities 1W: -3.77% | 1M: -6.66%; Energy 1W: -2.56% | 1M: +0.94%); overall Breadth: 2/11 sectors positive.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Watch a sustained close above recent 1W highs for NVDA (1W: +2.39% | 1M: +5.53%) ABOVE TREND to confirm continuation and for INTC (1W: +17.09% | 1M: +45.62%) ABOVE TREND to hold 1W gains as a sign of durable leadership; a break below this week’s lows in ORCL (1W: -7.34% | 1M: -3.61%) BELOW TREND would confirm further downside. Monitor RECOVERY names (LRCX (1W: +14.18% | 1M: -2.28%) RECOVERY, AMAT (1W: +13.62% | 1M: -1.21%) RECOVERY) for follow-through versus fade.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

(Other listed bullish names present in the news set require cross-check of intraday timeframes for confirmation.)

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, style mixed / no clear leadership. INTC (1W: +17.09% | 1M: +45.62%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +15.44% | 1M: +31.32%) ABOVE TREND and META (1W: +14.05% | 1M: +36.51%) ABOVE TREND are showing the most relative strength. Key risk: very narrow Technology leadership and major 1W vs 1M divergences (multiple RECOVERY names and ORCL/INTU persistent weakness) — watch for trend break or fade.
